description: This file defines the ConnectException class in the GuzzleHttp library, representing an exception thrown when a network connection cannot be established during an HTTP request.

classes.name: ConnectException
classes.description: An exception class indicating failure to establish a network connection, extending TransferException and implementing NetworkExceptionInterface.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request object that caused the exception.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Returns contextual information about the error from the underlying handler.
